title: Sunday · Bad Color · the flats
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: One of the first ten Sundays, over-wet: the flats with the sky run into the mud, the chimney a bleed, a man and a dog barely held in the middle tier. The book keeps it to show the learning.
